content: Round 1: Use image1 as opening frame — POSEIDON left, APOLLO right. Full reactive fighting game HUD: yellow health bar left, green health bar right, animated portraits, combo counters, damage sparks, ROUND 1 center, SUPER bars bottom. Health bars MUST dynamically decrease with every successful hit, block damage, elemental attack, and ultimate collision. Visible stagger animations, cinematic hit-stop, armor cracks, splash effects, fire bursts, glowing particles, and environmental destruction. Ultra-photorealistic cinematic. Dark mythological fantasy. Mortal Kombat style. 16:9 widescreen.  Arena: A gigantic divine Greek temple split between storm and sunlight. Left side: violent ocean cliffs, crashing tidal waves, black thunderclouds, blue lightning, shattered marble statues underwater. Right side: radiant golden temples, blazing sunlight, celestial fire, glowing pillars, floating golden dust particles. Wet reflective marble floor across the entire arena. Cinematic volumetric lighting. Epic god-war atmosphere.  CHARACTERS:  * POSEIDON (left): Massive muscular sea god with white beard, glowing blue eyes, ocean-forged bronze armor, dark teal royal cloth flowing in storm winds, gigantic trident crackling with lightning. Uses tidal waves, sea monsters, storms, water spears, whirlpools, and thunder magic. * APOLLO (right): Golden-haired sun god with radiant glowing skin, golden Greek armor and silk robes, halo crown of sunlight, celestial lyre weapon. Uses solar beams, fire magic, sun explosions, divine music waves, golden arrows, and radiant light attacks.  SHOT 1 (00:00–00:01) — ROUND 1 Start. Massive gothic gold “ROUND 1” text ignites center screen. Voice: “ROUND ONE. FIGHT!” Camera rockets violently through crashing waves, fire embers, lightning, and flying marble debris toward both gods. HUD powers on with glowing animations. Health bars full.  SHOT 2 (00:01–00:04) — DIRECT COMBAT. POSEIDON slams his trident into the ground, summoning massive ocean spikes erupting beneath APOLLO. First hit lands directly on APOLLO’S chest — HUGE IMPACT FLASH. APOLLO health bar drops 12%. Golden sparks and water explode across the arena.  APOLLO instantly dashes forward in a burst of solar light and strikes POSEIDON with a flaming sun spear combo. Massive explosion of fire and steam. POSEIDON health bar drops 15%. Water vapor fills the screen.  POSEIDON swings his gigantic trident horizontally, creating a tidal slash wave across the floor. APOLLO blocks partially with a radiant solar barrier — shield cracks under pressure. APOLLO health bar drops another 7% from block damage.  Camera performs aggressive 360° orbit around both gods. Every successful strike causes dynamic HUD shake, combo counters, cinematic hit-stop, damage numbers, and visible health reduction. SLOW MOTION 20% during heavy impacts — ocean spray, lightning, fire, molten debris, and shattered marble flying everywhere.  SHOT 3 (00:04–00:07) — SPECIAL ABILITIES. POSEIDON raises his trident to the storm sky and summons a gigantic MAELSTROM TSUNAMI crashing through the temple. APOLLO leaps upward surrounded by blazing golden sunlight and fires a MASSIVE SOLAR BEAM directly through the tidal wave. Steam explosion engulfs the arena.  POSEIDON health bar drops rapidly to 50%. APOLLO health bar drops rapidly to 42%.  APOLLO plays his celestial lyre — divine golden soundwaves ripple outward, shattering pillars and blasting POSEIDON backward through marble statues. POSEIDON counters by summoning giant spectral sea serpents erupting from whirlpools beneath APOLLO.  Camera ECU: burning sunlight colliding against black storm clouds and crashing oceans. SUPER meters charging rapidly with every hit. HUD flashes violently during major damage moments.  SHOT 4 (00:07–00:10) — TITAN CLASH. POSEIDON summons a GIGANTIC OCEAN TITAN made of storms, tidal waves, and lightning. APOLLO summons a MASSIVE SOLAR PHOENIX forged from living sunfire and celestial energy.  SLOW MOTION 15%: both titans charge across the battlefield. Ocean Titan trident collides directly against the Solar Phoenix explosion center screen.  Massive collision erupts into a catastrophic explosion of ocean water, lightning, solar fire, molten gold, thunder, steam clouds, and shattered temple debris.  POSEIDON health bar drops from 50% to 4%. APOLLO health bar drops from 42% to 2%.  HUD enters CRITICAL state — flashing red warnings, cracked UI effects, distorted sound, low-health heartbeat audio, electrical interference effects.  Camera RUSHES directly into the explosion of storm and sunlight.  SHOT 5 (00:13–00:15) — EPIC DRAW. Both gods violently slammed into opposite temple pillars. Entire arena collapsing into ocean abyss and solar flames. Rain, fire embers, shattered statues, lightning, smoke, steam, and debris everywhere.  POSEIDON struggles to rise as ocean water floods the arena floor. APOLLO’S radiant halo flickers and begins collapsing into sparks.  Final delayed damage ticks activate simultaneously.  POSEIDON health bar empties completely. APOLLO health bar empties completely.  LOUD announcer voice: “DOUBLE K.O.”  FREEZE FRAME. Giant burning gothic gold text: “EPIC DRAW”.  Camera slow cinematic orbit through smoke, ocean mist, lightning, and drifting golden ash as the HUD glitches and fades out.  Hard cut to black.
